malformed_policy.primary_metric: malformed counts as incorrect and stays in the denominator

primary_metric_aggregation.denominator_policy: failed parses are never dropped from the denominator
primary_metric_aggregation.procedure: exact semantic-class correctness per development transition, grouped by family identity, accuracy within each family, arithmetic mean across the four development families

safety_metric_fields.clean_exact_error_count: total incorrect predictions on clean cases (malformed + wrong class + not-applicable on transition)
safety_metric_fields.clean_malformed_count: malformed output on a clean case
safety_metric_fields.clean_not_applicable_count: NOT_APPLICABLE emitted on a clean transition
safety_metric_fields.spurious_basis_removal_count: gold removed=false, prediction removed=true (gold NEITHER or SURVIVES_ONLY, prediction REMOVES_ONLY or BOTH)
safety_metric_fields.valid_basis_rejection_count: gold survives=true, prediction survives=false (gold SURVIVES_ONLY or BOTH, prediction NEITHER or REMOVES_ONLY)
